basis: Blue Apron’s February 10 earnings release was the earliest qualifying communication found. Its consolidated statement of operations reports net revenue of $107,007,000 for the three months ended December 31, 2021 and $115,458,000 for the same quarter of 2020. That was a 7.32% decline. Q4 2021 revenue was $2,678,100 below the $109,685,100 cutoff.

coverage.detail: August 3 Q2 release. Blue Apron expected high-single-digit to low-double-digit revenue growth for FY2021 and growth for the second half as a whole. Neither forecast supplied a Q4 revenue ceiling.
August 3 public earnings call. Management discussed the full-year outlook and second-half spending and demand. No separate numerical Q4 net revenue ceiling was identified.
November 4 capital-raise announcement. The $78 million figure was equity financing. It supplied no Q4 sales forecast.

November 9 Q3 release. Management forecast single-digit FY2021 revenue growth and discussed increased Q4 promotional discounts. As a secondary arithmetic check, 3% annual growth on FY2020 revenue of $460,608,000, less reported nine-month 2021 revenue of $363,370,000, would imply Q4 revenue of $111,056,240. That exceeds the cutoff, so the annual language allowed outcomes above it.

November 9 public earnings call, including Q&A. CFO Randy Greben identified Q4 2019 as the relevant comparison for Q4 2021. He gave no numerical Q4 revenue growth rate against 2019 to convert. His single-digit growth forecast applied to FY2021.
November 9 issuer presentation. Slide 6 described additional Q4 promotions intended to support growth starting in 2022. Slide 10’s $109.7 million was reported Q3 revenue.
December 16 intervening 8-K. The disclosure concerned Delaware stockholder litigation and contained no quarterly sales update.

January 20 issuer notice distributed by Business Wire. It scheduled the February 10 results and webcast without preliminary revenue figures. The intervening search found no earlier qualifying management update.

February 10 actuals. The consolidated GAAP table gives both December-quarter amounts in thousands on the same net revenue line. The release’s separate 13% growth headline compares Q4 2021 with Q4 2019.
EDGAR records acceptance of the results 8-K at 06:40:44 on February 10, 2022 and identifies the earnings release as Exhibit 99.1.

publication_date_evidence: The issuer’s Exhibit 99.1 is datelined New York, February 10, 2022 and says Blue Apron announced the fourth-quarter results that day. The same-day SEC acceptance independently confirms public availability.
